rule: The repo carries its starter files: README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONSTRAINTS.tsv, GLOSSARY.md, VERIFY.md, VERSION with RELEASES.md, scripts/check and scripts/private-boundary.py

No tracked private file name, absolute home path, A-number, SSN or listed private marker; no tracked PDF, image or .docx unless scripts/private-boundary.allow lists it with a reason; a missing private names list warns
proof: a tracked .env, scan.pdf, /Users/<name>/ path, A-number or SSN fails
notes: names live in the untracked .git/info/private-markers, one per line; without it the names scan is skipped with a warning locally and a note in CI

rule: CI runs scripts/check --tests on every PR
proof: a red check fails the PR

rule: Every tracked Python, shell and JSON file parses
proof: a syntax error in a tracked .py, .sh or .json file fails scripts/check
notes: shallow on purpose; add the repo's own linter here

rule: README.md is the repo's short current truth: a one-line purpose, a Status table (Version matching VERSION, Works, Next), one or two Mermaid diagrams within scripts/diagram-lint.py, a pointer to AGENTS.md, no history and at most 80 lines
proof: a README whose Status Version differs from VERSION, with no diagram, or with a dated line fails scripts/check

rule: A PR that changes behavior (any non-Markdown file) also touches README.md, RELEASES.md, VERIFY.md or a file under docs/, or its body says 'No doc change needed: <why>'
proof: a PR changing scripts/check alone, with no such body line, fails CI
notes: locally there is no PR body, so it skips; CI reads the body and reruns when it is edited
